title: Can Pinnacle Occupational Therapy help my child with autism improve transitions between tasks?
metaTitle: Autism and Task Transition - Pinnacle Blooms Network Occupational Therapy
description: Ease the anxiety caused by shifting between tasks with Pinnacle Blooms Network's structured Occupational Therapy. Using tools such as visual schedules, social stories, and practical countdowns, we make task transition smooth for children with autism.
html: Yes, transitions can be tough, especially for a child with autism. But don't worry, with Pinnacle Blooms Network's dedicated Occupational Therapy, we can certainly assist. Our therapists use tools such as visual schedules, social stories, and practical countdowns. We also practice transitions during therapy sessions, making it more predictable and manageable for your child. We're here to guide your child smoothly through these day-to-day shifts.
